requiredFindings.title: The fixed/variable byte decomposition omits required wire values
requiredFindings.evidence: occupancy-v1.schema.json requires schemaVersion with const 1. The reported 139 bytes count only the map head and ten keys; the fixed uint value adds one byte, making 140. The clones near row excludes its unresolved resolution value from candidateFixedBytes, but perCandidate.variable and candidateBytes omit an explicit encoded-resolution term.
requiredFindings.impact: The record labelled exact fixed bytes undercounts occupancy companions, and its purported closed candidate/spool/payload formulas do not account for the unresolved near resolution when that owner later binds it.
requiredFindings.requiredCorrection: Use 140 fixed occupancy-companion bytes, including schemaVersion=1, or explicitly identify 139 as head-and-keys only and account for the constant separately. Add an explicit text(resolution_near) variable term with A6 and its binding owner unresolved; the 334-byte near row must be labelled as excluding that required value. Propagate corrections through the derivation, JSON and report, preserving the measured census and every unbound owner parameter.

requiredFindings.title: The frame formula assumes uniform full packing rather than retaining G3 batching as unset
requiredFindings.evidence: d_frames uses ceil(candidates_stage / batchSize) as the exact number of FactBatch frames. The cited contracts cap nonempty batches at 4096 candidates and bound frame bytes; they do not require every nonfinal batch to fill a single uniform batchSize. M3-L r6:589 leaves batching with G3.
requiredFindings.impact: A variable partition can have more frames than this expression predicts. For four candidates and a count cap of two, batches of sizes 1,2,1 are count-lawful and produce three frames, while ceil(4/2) is two. Byte-driven or other owner-selected flushes likewise need not follow uniform packing. This unstated assumption prevents the decomposition from being a general closed formula with all choices left open.
requiredFindings.requiredCorrection: Express frame count in terms of the actual batch partition/frame count supplied by G3, explicitly unset, and preserve C4a grouping and the unresolved response-frame scope. If retaining ceil(C/B), label it only as a conditional uniform-full-packing case rather than the general formula. Do not select a packing policy or rerun the compiler census.
